_comment: Editorial content for AGLNCPS. This is a preference-share line of Agritech Limited, not a separate business. No image is attached.
description: Agritech Non-Voting (Preferred) Class A is a non-voting preference share class of Agritech Limited, the PSX-listed fertilizer maker whose ordinary shares trade as AGL. Agritech produces urea at Iskandarabad, District Mianwali and granulated single super phosphate at Haripur, sold under the Tara brand. This line carries no voting rights and is a separate class of capital from the ordinary shares.
sourceNote: PSX Data Portal security record for AGLNCPS (name 'Agritech Non-Voting (Pref) Class A') and the PSX Data Portal company record for the issuer, AGL, read 2026-10-17.
